channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Sexual Health strategy submissions to be presented to cabinet for discussion, minister tells House
item.description: Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela says the strategy will be implemented once submissions are discussed and approved by the cabinet

item.title: Have you seen this man? Police appeal to public to help track down man
item.description: The public has been asked to help locate a man, who is being sought by the police in relation to an ongoing court case

item.title: WATCH | Abela wants a pragmatic solution on Greenland without escalating tensions
item.description: When asked about Malta's position in the upcoming emergency summit, Prime Minister Robert Abela kept his cards close to his chest, but stated that the EU cannot appear weak following the summit

item.title: WATCH | Government in talks with businesses over Storm Harry damage compensation
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela confirmed government is in individual talks and is looking at numerous cases to assess what damages were suffered

item.title: Clyde Caruana takes aim at Opposition: You have it wrong on the economy
item.description: Finance Minister Clyde Caruana defends government’s fiscal policy, saying political digs by the Opposition on debt, deficit and spending are disproved by statistics

item.title: Prime Minister acknowledges GWUs work in improving workers conditions
item.description: The Prime Minister praised the GWU’s contribution to Malta’s development, saying it was crucial in achieving social progress and securing important gains for workers

item.title: Permanent Secretary Ronald Mizzi says Storm Harry shed light on Gozo’s double insularity challenges
item.description: Ronald Mizzi Permanent Secretary within the Office of the Prime Minister calls for a more serious and less romanticised debate on a permanent link between Malta and Gozo after ferry services were suspended for nearly two days due to Storm Harry

item.title: Government MPs shoot down Opposition motion expressing concern over Greenland
item.description: Maltese Parliament fails to agree on relatively meek statement expressing concern over ‘recent public statements’ that put into question Greenland’s future and status • Government MPs say motion is premature

item.title: Malta leads EU tourism growth as overnight stays reach record high
item.description: Malta led tourism growth in the European Union in 2025, recording the largest year-on-year increase in nights spent at tourist accommodation

item.title: Modernist HSBC branch in St Paul’s Bay faces the chop
item.description: A nine-storey hotel is being proposed in place of the former HSBC branch in Triq San Pawl, St Paul’s Bay
